sourceFile: 7. BRS-161016(DT) Sunmary Report TEST new JIG improve use new dry machine 2024.06.7_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable test evidence but the changed-factor and comparison grouping are not reliable.
issues: Changed factor is an invented baseline-vs-run-number comparison.
Primary condition mixes new dry machine and improved jig ambiguously.
Run numbers, dates, and rounds are treated as changed conditions instead of subgroups.
Outcome should be OK/NG dry-result yield, not a generic measurement.
Summary and 7.6 rows appear duplicated or hierarchical but are not reconciled.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the primary factor be new dry machine, improved jig, or the combined new-machine-plus-jig condition?
correctionPlan: Replace changed factor with the validated equipment/jig condition from title, purpose, and content rows.
Set baseline as not explicit unless a normal-machine or old-jig row is found.
Move date, round, time, temperature, and jig height to subgroup keys.
Group outcomes as input, OK, NG categories, total NG, and NG rate.
Reconcile Summary totals with 7.6 detailed rows and avoid double counting.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are insufficient for the current comparison claim.
